LanguageData.LP_FateRewriteCharm.label: fate talisman
LanguageData.LP_FateRewriteCharm.description: A cinnabar talisman issued by the system, its edges glowing faintly blue. Use it on yourself or another colonist in the same place to rewrite one trait into another trait of the same tier (curses can only become curses; legendary deeds, gene-granted traits and story traits can't be rewritten). Burns up after use.\n\nWith a fate talisman in the pack, click the "fate talisman" button below the pawn to use it; when it's on the ground, select it to use.
